title: Beyond Maximum Likelihood: Variational Inequality Estimation for Generalized Linear Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.03087v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generalized linear models (GLMs) are fundamental tools for statistical modeling, with maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) serving as the classical approach for parameter inference. While MLE performs well for canonical GLMs, it can become computationally challenging in more general settings with non-canonical, non-smooth, or saturating link functions, where the resulting optimization landscape may be ill-conditioned, non-convex, or non-differentiable. In this paper, we study an alternative estimation framework based on variational inequalities (VIs), which formulates GLM estimation through an operator-based equilibrium condition rather than likelihood minimization. We analyze the VI estimator from a statistical perspective and establish finite-sample error bounds and asymptotic normality, together with convergence guarantees for fixed-point and stochastic approximation algorithms. translated_title: 超越最大似然：广义线性模型的变分不等式估计
translated_abstract: 广义线性模型（GLMs）是统计建模的基础工具，最大似然估计（MLE）是参数推断的经典方法。虽然MLE在标准（canonical）GLMs中表现良好，但在更一般的情形下——例如具有非标准、非光滑或饱和连接函数的设置——它可能在计算上变得困难，因为由此产生的优化问题可能是病态的、非凸的或不可微的。本文研究了一种基于变分不等式（VIs）的替代估计框架，该框架通过基于算子的均衡条件而非似然最小化来构建GLM估计。我们从统计角度分析了VI估计量，建立了有限样本误差界和渐近正态性，并给出了不动点算法和随机逼近算法的收敛性保证。该框架适用于一大类连接函数。
tldr: 本文提出用基于变分不等式的算子均衡条件取代最大似然来估计广义线性模型，证明了其有限样本误差界与渐近正态性以及相应算法的收敛保证，并能处理非标准、非光滑或饱和的连接函数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes estimating generalized linear models through variational inequality-based operator equilibrium conditions instead of maximum likelihood, establishing finite-sample error bounds, asymptotic normality, and convergence guarantees for the associated algorithms, while accommodating non-canonical, non-smooth, or saturating link functions.
